note: Status of every Directive 24 client-authority item in the commercial / publishing scope. Evidence ids refer to tests/backend (AUTH-xxx, Firebase Emulator) and tests/unit.

items.now: plans/{planId}; written only by upsertPlan / setPlanPricing / setPlanFeature / duplicatePlan / deletePlan (App Owner)
entitlementOverrides/{id} with explicit tenantId; upsertOverride / deleteOverride (App Owner); expiry evaluated server-side
usageCounters (server-measured or consumeQuota, transactional, idempotent) + usageLedger
entitlementAuditLogs / commercialAuditLogs / platformAuditLogs, create-only in the mutation's transaction, content-hashed, client-unwritable
subscriptions/{type}_{id}; backend lifecycle; customers can only check out (verified payment) or cancel

items.value: Plan chosen during onboarding triggers immediate upgrade
items.now: onboarding requests a server-priced checkout; refused while payments are disabled, publishing continues on Free

items.previously: client JavaScript (secret in bundle, any 16+ char signature accepted)
items.now: functions/src/billing: HMAC-SHA256 with Secret Manager secrets, constant-time compare, raw-body webhook verification, provider re-check of captured amount

items.value: Actor role passed into service mutations ({ role: 'app_owner' })
items.now: role derived from the verified token claim + users/{uid}; payload role fields rejected
publishingRecords/{entityId} + backend-mirrored publicationHidden / platformSuspended enforced by firestore.rules

items.previously: URL parameter bypassed the local check
items.now: hidden entities are unreadable by the public under firestore.rules; the preview flag only chooses which notice a member sees
slugs/{slug} written by setPublishingState (ownership, takeover protection, reserved routes from shared/domain/slugRules)
items.quarantine: A slug released by a slug change is quarantined for 90 days (slugs/{slug}.quarantinedUntil); only its previous owner may reclaim it.

items.value: Pilot registry and account deletion state

outOfScope.value: Demo data store served to signed-out visitors
outOfScope.reason: class D; later directive. Note: anonymous slug queries are also refused by the Directive 24 rules (query cannot prove isCompanyActive), so public pages for real customers need a slug-index lookup when CA-31 is addressed.
